selection: highest minimum raw relative abundance across a matched August/February pair, separately Thermoplasmatota and Bacteria; HSP20 strict carrier
pilot: first5000000pairedrecords, technical coverage gate only, no seasonal inference from read prefix
full_gate: at least5xprojected full depth and at least0.5 observed pilot breadth for marker and background; real full-depth gate >=5xmedian and>=.9breadth; expand site replication only if feasible
